reading: Waymo has temporarily suspended freeway services for its driverless taxis across the United States.
The decision followed a California ban after a series of traffic incidents involving the company's vehicles.
California officials said the taxis created a safety risk by repeatedly entering construction zones where people were working.
In one incident, several Waymo vehicles entered an active construction zone on US Route 101.
Waymo said no injuries or collisions were reported after the incident on US Route 101.
In another incident, video appeared to show a Waymo car trying to pass vehicles that were deliberately slowing traffic.
California's ban took effect on 11 November.
The restrictions will remain until Waymo shows state officials it has taken effective steps to deal with the problems.
Waymo said it also paused freeway services in its other markets to evaluate how its vehicles were performing.
The company said it was working with state officials to resume freeway services.
Its driverless taxis can still operate on regular city streets.

vocabulary.definition: Stopped an activity for a period of time.
Several similar or related things happening one after another.
Areas where roads or other structures are being built or repaired.
Accidents in which vehicles hit something, such as another vehicle.
With a clear intention, rather than by accident.
Rules that limit what someone or something is allowed to do.
Examine something carefully to judge how good or effective it is.
Start an activity after it has stopped for a time.

entries.ja: ある活動を一定の期間、停止した。
entries.ko: 어떤 활동을 일정 기간 동안 중단했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 将某项活动停止了一段时间。
entries.es: Detuvo una actividad durante un período de tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Interrompeu uma atividade por um período de tempo.
entries.fr: A interrompu une activité pendant un certain temps.
entries.de: Hat eine Tätigkeit für eine gewisse Zeit unterbrochen.

entries.ja: 似たことや関連することが、いくつも次々に起こること。
entries.ko: 비슷하거나 서로 관련된 여러 일이 잇따라 일어나는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 多个相似或相关的事情接连发生。
entries.es: Varias cosas similares o relacionadas que suceden una tras otra.
entries.pt-BR: Várias coisas semelhantes ou relacionadas que acontecem uma após a outra.
entries.fr: Plusieurs choses semblables ou liées qui se produisent les unes après les autres.
entries.de: Mehrere ähnliche oder zusammenhängende Dinge, die nacheinander geschehen.

entries.ja: 道路やその他の構造物を建設したり修理したりしている区域。
entries.ko: 도로나 그 밖의 구조물을 짓거나 보수하고 있는 구역.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在修建或维修道路或其他建筑结构的区域。
entries.es: Zonas donde se están construyendo o reparando carreteras u otras estructuras.
entries.pt-BR: Áreas onde estradas ou outras estruturas estão sendo construídas ou reparadas.
entries.fr: Zones où des routes ou d’autres structures sont en cours de construction ou de réparation.
entries.de: Bereiche, in denen Straßen oder andere Bauwerke gebaut oder repariert werden.

entries.ja: 車両が別の車両など、何かにぶつかる事故。

entries.zh-Hans: 车辆撞上其他车辆等物体的事故。
entries.es: Accidentes en los que los vehículos chocan contra algo, como otro vehículo.
entries.pt-BR: Acidentes em que veículos batem em algo, como outro veículo.
entries.fr: Accidents dans lesquels des véhicules heurtent quelque chose, par exemple un autre véhicule.
entries.de: Unfälle, bei denen Fahrzeuge gegen etwas stoßen, zum Beispiel gegen ein anderes Fahrzeug.

entries.ja: 偶然ではなく、はっきりとした意図を持って。
entries.zh-Hans: 带着明确的意图，而不是出于偶然。
entries.es: Con una intención clara, en lugar de por accidente.
entries.pt-BR: Com uma intenção clara, e não por acaso.
entries.fr: Avec une intention claire, et non par accident.
entries.de: Mit klarer Absicht und nicht zufällig.

entries.ja: 人や物に許される行動の範囲を制限する規則。
entries.ko: 사람이나 사물에 허용되는 행동의 범위를 제한하는 규칙.
entries.zh-Hans: 限制某人或某事物可以做什么的规定。
entries.es: Normas que limitan lo que alguien o algo tiene permitido hacer.
entries.pt-BR: Regras que limitam o que alguém ou alguma coisa tem permissão para fazer.
entries.fr: Règles qui limitent ce qu’une personne ou une chose est autorisée à faire.
entries.de: Regeln, die einschränken, was jemand oder etwas tun darf.

entries.ja: 何かがどれほど優れているか、または効果があるかを判断するために、注意深く調べること。
entries.ko: 무언가가 얼마나 좋거나 효과적인지 판단하기 위해 주의 깊게 살펴보는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 仔细检查某事物，以判断它有多好或多有效。
entries.es: Examinar algo con cuidado para juzgar qué tan bueno o eficaz es.
entries.pt-BR: Examinar algo com cuidado para julgar sua qualidade ou eficácia.
entries.fr: Examiner quelque chose avec soin pour juger de sa qualité ou de son efficacité.
entries.de: Etwas sorgfältig untersuchen, um zu beurteilen, wie gut oder wirksam es ist.

entries.ja: しばらく中断していた活動を再び始めること。
entries.ko: 한동안 중단되었던 활동을 다시 시작하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在某项活动停止一段时间后重新开始。
entries.es: Volver a empezar una actividad después de que se haya detenido durante un tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Voltar a realizar uma atividade depois de ela ter ficado interrompida por um tempo.
entries.fr: Recommencer une activité après une interruption d’un certain temps.
entries.de: Eine Tätigkeit nach einer gewissen Unterbrechung wieder aufnehmen.
